description: Tamil Nadu's 2026 Budget prioritizes AI initiatives for education, governance, and industry, allocating ₹398 crore for transformative projects.
body_lead: The new Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)-led Tamil Nadu Government has identified Artificial Intelligence as a key priority, with its first Budget including multiple AI-focused initiatives to improve education, governance, and industrial growth. The government has announced the establishment of an AI and innovation city called ‘Arivagam’, where AI companies, startups, Global Capability Centres (GCCs), and other research institutions working in domains such as quantum technology and computer infrastructure will come together to develop the state’s AI and deep tech ecosystem.
